rules.description: Verifies that both adolescent birth rate StatVars share the same latest observation year.
Verifies that the latest observation year for every StatVar is within an allowable 3-year reporting lag of the current year.

params.condition: COALESCE(TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR)), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3, FALSE)
